text: The art of carpentry involves constructing furniture and other structures by using various tools and techniques. Joints, such as榫 (xuàn) joints, are essential for connecting pieces of wood together to create a solid structure. These joints allow for smooth transitions between different sections of the project and help prevent warping or deformation over time. Additionally, varnish is often used to protect and enhance the appearance of the finished product. To achieve this, a process called finishing involves applying a thin layer of varnish or paint to smooth out any rough edges or imperfections and create a durable, weather-resistant finish.
